name: ACI 318-19 + ASCE 7-22
description: The US pack, loads first: ASCE/SEI 7-22 load combinations (Sec 2.3, 2.4), live loads and their reduction (Ch 4), the seismic design of buildings from the site's mapped spectral values (Ch 11-12: risk categories, site classes, the two-period and multi-period spectra, Seismic Design Categories, R, Cd and Omega0, the equivalent lateral force method with its Cs bounds and Cu, modal scaling, drift limits, irregularities, diaphragm forces, P-Delta), wind (Ch 26-30: the ASCE 7-22 terrain constants; the pressure coefficients the editions share) and roof snow (Ch 7). Concrete, steel and the other materials are not in this version: they fall back to the pack it extends (BNBC 2020, whose concrete chapter follows ACI 318), and the report names every table that falls back. Every value has its clause in VERIFY.md, to be checked against the printed standards.

sources.title: Minimum Design Loads and Associated Criteria for Buildings and Other Structures (ASCE/SEI 7-22)
Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete (ACI 318-19)

locations: ASCE 7-22 Sec 11.4.2, 26.5.1, 7.2: site values from the ASCE Hazard Tool

basis.steel: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 10 (AISC 360-22 not yet in the pack)
